# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

## Who we are

The AO is a medically-guided, not-for-profit organization, a global network of surgeons, and the
premier education, innovation, and research organization for the surgical treatment of trauma and
musculoskeletal disorders.

### News

Get all the latest information on AO activities, all over the world, updates from the AO community
and the most recent AO innovations.

[Find out more][142]

### Global community

Whatever stage you are at in your career, wherever you are in the world, you can be part of the AO's
international community of educators, innovators, researchers, and surgeons.

[Find out more][143]

### Our services and resources

The health care environment today is more complex than ever before. Find valuable support in AO
resources, for education, innovation, and research.

[Find out more][144]

### Contact

Explore the diverse opportunities the AO offers to specialists in a wide range of fields. Find your
AO pathway.

[Contact us][145]
[Find out more][146]

## What we do

The AO's world-leading institutes drive development, innovation, and research, across the AO by
delivering value-added products and services to the AO's clinical specialties, its global network of
surgeons and operating room personnel, and to its partners. They produce new concepts for improved
fracture care, deliver evidence-based decision making, guarantee rigorous concept and product
approval, and ensure the timely and comprehensive dissemination of knowledge and expertise. Find out
more about the [AO Research Institute Davos (ARI)][147], the [AO Innovation Translation
Center][148], the AO's clinical research activities, and the [AO Education Institute (AO EI)][149].

## Who we are

The AO is a medically-guided, not-for-profit organization, a global network of surgeons, and the
premier education, innovation, and research organization for the surgical treatment of trauma and
musculoskeletal disorders.

### News

Get all the latest information on AO activities, all over the world, updates from the AO community
and the most recent AO innovations.

[Find out more][142]

### Global community

Whatever stage you are at in your career, wherever you are in the world, you can be part of the AO's
international community of educators, innovators, researchers, and surgeons.

[Find out more][143]

### Our services and resources

The health care environment today is more complex than ever before. Find valuable support in AO
resources, for education, innovation, and research.

[Find out more][144]

### Contact

Explore the diverse opportunities the AO offers to specialists in a wide range of fields. Find your
AO pathway.

[Contact us][145]
[Find out more][146]

## What we do

The AO's world-leading institutes drive development, innovation, and research, across the AO by
delivering value-added products and services to the AO's clinical specialties, its global network of
surgeons and operating room personnel, and to its partners. They produce new concepts for improved
fracture care, deliver evidence-based decision making, guarantee rigorous concept and product
approval, and ensure the timely and comprehensive dissemination of knowledge and expertise. Find out
more about the [AO Research Institute Davos (ARI)][147], the [AO Innovation Translation
Center][148], the AO's clinical research activities, and the [AO Education Institute (AO EI)][149].

## Colorado Spine Partners

Colorado Spine Partners is a group practice composed of four fellowship-trained orthopedic spine
surgeons. Our philosophy emphasizes exhausting non-surgical treatment options before considering
spine surgery. When surgery is necessary, they utilize the latest technological advances in
minimally invasive spine.

#### Non-surgical Treatments

Our physicians emphasize a non-surgical approach before considering spine surgery.

#### Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery

Learn about spine procedures such as ALIF, LIF, PLIF, TLIF that Dr. Wong, Dr. Jatana and Dr.
Ghiselli perform.

#### Lumbar Microsurgery

Dr. David Wong is a fellowship-trained board-certified orthopedic spine surgeon with a specialty in
lumbar microsurgery

# Artificial Disc Replacement

For patients with cervical disc herniation or degeneration, Dr. Jatana offers Mobi-C® artificial
disc replacement as an option to preserve motion in the neck compared to traditional cervical
fusion.

The advantages of the Mobi-C® device over traditional cervical fusion is that the artificial disc
maintains normal motion and reduces the stress placed on the other discs in the neck. The goal with
motion preservation is to retain the normal rotation of the neck and lessen the need for any future
surgery at other levels in the neck.

[Learn More][36]

# Conservative Treatment Options

The spine physicians at Colorado Spine Partners share the same philosophy in that they emphasize
nonsurgical treatment options in advance of spine surgery. Non-surgical treatment options are now
provided through pain management specialists and spine therapists.
[Learn More][37]

## Colorado Spine Partners

Colorado Spine Partners is a group practice composed of four fellowship-trained orthopedic spine
surgeons. Our philosophy emphasizes exhausting non-surgical treatment options before considering
spine surgery. When surgery is necessary, they utilize the latest technological advances in
minimally invasive spine.

#### Non-surgical Treatments

Our physicians emphasize a non-surgical approach before considering spine surgery.

#### Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery

Learn about spine procedures such as ALIF, LIF, PLIF, TLIF that Dr. Wong, Dr. Jatana and Dr.
Ghiselli perform.

#### Lumbar Microsurgery

Dr. David Wong is a fellowship-trained board-certified orthopedic spine surgeon with a specialty in
lumbar microsurgery

# Artificial Disc Replacement

For patients with cervical disc herniation or degeneration, Dr. Jatana offers Mobi-C® artificial
disc replacement as an option to preserve motion in the neck compared to traditional cervical
fusion.

The advantages of the Mobi-C® device over traditional cervical fusion is that the artificial disc
maintains normal motion and reduces the stress placed on the other discs in the neck. The goal with
motion preservation is to retain the normal rotation of the neck and lessen the need for any future
surgery at other levels in the neck.

[Learn More][36]

# Conservative Treatment Options

The spine physicians at Colorado Spine Partners share the same philosophy in that they emphasize
nonsurgical treatment options in advance of spine surgery. Non-surgical treatment options are now
provided through pain management specialists and spine therapists.
[Learn More][37]

affiliated nonsurgical spine MDs, fellowship-trained spine specialized surgeons and spine
therapists. The spine team emphasizes nonsurgical treatment options; minimally invasive spine
surgery; motion preservation surgery via artificial disc replacement, patient education; and home
remedies for back and neck pain.

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

### About Practice

OBGYN CARE is a premier women’s health practice caring for patients in two locations in Newport
Beach and Irvine, California. Catalin Marinescu, MD, FACOG, offers expert care for women’s health,
including obstetrics and gynecology, along with infertility. 

Dr. Marinescu is highly proficient in minimally invasive surgery with the da VinciⓇ robotic system
and has earned the practice a Center of Excellence Designation. He prides himself on having no
complications whatsoever during any of his procedures, giving peace of mind to patients.

The team at OBGYN CARE caters to women of all cultural backgrounds and ages at every stage of their
health journeys. They provide a variety of services, including pregnancy care and gynecological care
for issues such as endometriosis, pelvic pain, and ovarian cysts. Patients also seek help for
urogynecological issues such as urinary incontinence, interstitial cystitis, and bladder pain.

At OBGYN CARE, every aspect of women’s health care is exceptional, inclusive, and compassionate with
the goal of exceeding patient expectations and giving them the best possible outcomes. To learn more
or make an appointment, call one of the offices or use the online booking tool on this website.

[
[DaVinci robot]

##### Modern Fibroid Treatment: How Laparoscopic and Robotic Myomectomy Work

][71]

Minimally invasive myomectomy uses laparoscopic and robotic surgery to remove uterine fibroids with
smaller incisions, faster recovery, and fertility preservation. Learn benefits, risks, and treatment
options at OBGYN-CARE with Dr. Marinescu.

[
[Menstrual hygiene products]

##### Why Fibroids Can Cause Heavy Bleeding

][72]

By age 50, 70–80% of women will develop fibroids, although many remain asymptomatic. When symptoms
occur, heavy bleeding is the most frequent. Understanding why fibroids cause excessive bleeding
helps women recognize when their symptoms are not normal.

[
[Uterus model with fibroids]

##### A Short Guide on How Fibroids Affect Fertility

][73]

Uterine fibroids affect up to 70% of women and can reduce fertility by 70%, especially submucosal
types. They may cause miscarriage, preterm birth, and complications, but treatment can improve
outcomes.

### About Practice

OBGYN CARE is a premier women’s health practice caring for patients in two locations in Newport
Beach and Irvine, California. Catalin Marinescu, MD, FACOG, offers expert care for women’s health,
including obstetrics and gynecology, along with infertility. 

Dr. Marinescu is highly proficient in minimally invasive surgery with the da VinciⓇ robotic system
and has earned the practice a Center of Excellence Designation. He prides himself on having no
complications whatsoever during any of his procedures, giving peace of mind to patients.

The team at OBGYN CARE caters to women of all cultural backgrounds and ages at every stage of their
health journeys. They provide a variety of services, including pregnancy care and gynecological care
for issues such as endometriosis, pelvic pain, and ovarian cysts. Patients also seek help for
urogynecological issues such as urinary incontinence, interstitial cystitis, and bladder pain.

At OBGYN CARE, every aspect of women’s health care is exceptional, inclusive, and compassionate with
the goal of exceeding patient expectations and giving them the best possible outcomes. To learn more
or make an appointment, call one of the offices or use the online booking tool on this website.

##### Modern Fibroid Treatment: How Laparoscopic and Robotic Myomectomy Work

][71]

Minimally invasive myomectomy uses laparoscopic and robotic surgery to remove uterine fibroids with
smaller incisions, faster recovery, and fertility preservation. Learn benefits, risks, and treatment
options at OBGYN-CARE with Dr. Marinescu.

[
[Menstrual hygiene products]

##### Why Fibroids Can Cause Heavy Bleeding

][72]

By age 50, 70–80% of women will develop fibroids, although many remain asymptomatic. When symptoms
occur, heavy bleeding is the most frequent. Understanding why fibroids cause excessive bleeding
helps women recognize when their symptoms are not normal.

[
[Uterus model with fibroids]

##### A Short Guide on How Fibroids Affect Fertility

][73]

Uterine fibroids affect up to 70% of women and can reduce fertility by 70%, especially submucosal
types. They may cause miscarriage, preterm birth, and complications, but treatment can improve
outcomes.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

## Nasal Osteotomies
## Innovated by Sureyya Seneldir

## FAQ

### What is rhinoplasty surgery?

Rhinoplasty is a surgical procedure to reshape or repair the nose for cosmetic reasons or to improve
nasal function (e.g., breathing). It may involve altering the bone, cartilage, or skin of the nose.

### What are the main types of instruments used in rhinoplasty?

The main types of instruments used in rhinoplasty include:
* **Scalpels** (for making precise incisions),
* **Rongeurs** (for removing bone or cartilage),
* **Osteotomes** (for shaping bones),
* **Elevators** (for lifting tissues),
* **Forceps** (for grasping tissues),
* **Rasp** (for smoothing the nasal bone),
* **Cautery devices** (to stop bleeding),
* **Sutures** (for closing incisions).

### Why are osteotomes used in rhinoplasty?

Osteotomes are chisel-like instruments used to cut, reshape, or remove bone during rhinoplasty. They
are particularly useful when adjusting the shape of the nasal bones, such as narrowing the nose or
realigning the bones after a break.

### What is the purpose of nasal splints in rhinoplasty?

Nasal splints are applied after surgery to provide support and protect the nose during healing. They
help maintain the newly reshaped structure and reduce swelling while promoting proper healing.

### How are sutures used in rhinoplasty?

Sutures are used to close the incisions made during surgery. They can be either dissolvable
(absorbed by the body over time) or non-dissolvable (requiring removal after a few days). They
ensure the wound stays closed while healing occurs.

### What is the role of forceps in rhinoplasty?

Forceps are used to grasp or hold tissues, cartilage, or other structures during the surgery. Their
precision allows the surgeon to manipulate delicate areas without causing damage to the surrounding
tissue.

### Why is a surgical scalpel important in rhinoplasty?

A scalpel is essential for making precise, clean incisions that allow the surgeon to access the
nasal bones, cartilage, and skin without unnecessary trauma to the surrounding tissues. It ensures
minimal scarring.

### How does a rasp work in rhinoplasty?

A rasp is a tool used to smooth and shape the nasal bones after they have been cut or reshaped. It
works like a file, gently filing down rough edges and contouring the bone to achieve a smoother,
more aesthetically pleasing nose shape.

### What is a cautery device used for in rhinoplasty?

A cautery device is used to stop bleeding during surgery by sealing blood vessels. This minimizes
blood loss and helps maintain a clear surgical field, which is important for precision and safety.

works like a file, gently filing down rough edges and contouring the bone to achieve a smoother,
more aesthetically pleasing nose shape.

A cautery device is used to stop bleeding during surgery by sealing blood vessels. This minimizes
blood loss and helps maintain a clear surgical field, which is important for precision and safety.

A nasal speculum is an instrument used to widen the nostrils, allowing the surgeon to have a better
view and access to the nasal cavity during surgery. It helps in visualizing internal nasal

Surgical suction is used to remove blood, fluids, or debris from the surgical area. This ensures the
surgeon has a clear view of the nasal structures, which is crucial for precise and safe surgery.

After rhinoplasty, patients typically need to rest and avoid any strenuous activities for several

# Less Hardware.

Our mission is to improve patient quality of life by providing innovative and proven spine
technologies. We strive to make a positive impact in healthcare by providing superior, high quality
products that simplify spine surgery and reduce cost. 

[The VariLift®-LX SLIF Procedure][83]

## Simple, Strong, Screw-less

The Wenzel Spine's Standalone Fusion Solutions offer surgeons a simple surgical approach for
patients who may benefit from sacroiliac, lumbar or cervical fusion, *without the need for
supplemental fixation*. When it comes to spine treatment, often a "less is more" approach is a
better alternative for patients prioritizing less hardware, anatomy preservation, and spinal
longevity.

# Less Hardware.

Our mission is to improve patient quality of life by providing innovative and proven spine
technologies. We strive to make a positive impact in healthcare by providing superior, high quality
products that simplify spine surgery and reduce cost. 

[The VariLift®-LX SLIF Procedure][83]

## Simple, Strong, Screw-less

The Wenzel Spine's Standalone Fusion Solutions offer surgeons a simple surgical approach for
patients who may benefit from sacroiliac, lumbar or cervical fusion, *without the need for
supplemental fixation*. When it comes to spine treatment, often a "less is more" approach is a
better alternative for patients prioritizing less hardware, anatomy preservation, and spinal
longevity.
